_doc: Posting control as data. Edit by PR (or the owner flips kill). kill=true stops every channel at once. No patent is filed (NO-PATENT-1): the Ultrastable License is the protection, so no content is gated on a filing. REACH-1: mode=live by the owner's consent of 2026-11-17 (doctrine/reach.json consent); a channel still posts only when its bindings exist.
